label: Bond to 10
description: For a part a (1 through 9), there is a complementary part (10 - a) such that a + (10 - a) = 10. Each bond (e.g. 6+4=10) is treated as its own instance of this family, not assumed equivalent to its reverse (4+6=10) until commutativity is established.
source: Carpenter, Fennema, Franke, Levi & Empson, Children's Mathematics: Cognitively Guided Instruction (2nd ed., 2014)
